location: auth/token_cache.py -- the AuthError fallback in _refresh(), wrong only in light of the precondition under which get_token() reaches it
mechanism: The fallback returns the cached token on any AuthError without checking whether that token is still valid. get_token() only calls _refresh() once the cached token has already failed the expiry check, so on that path the fallback returns a token it knows to be expired and reports success. A revoked or misconfigured credential therefore produces an unbounded stream of 401s from every downstream service while the AuthError is downgraded to a warning and never propagates to any caller.
